fields.Name: AIUsageByModel
fields.UserQuestion: What is the efficiency, cost, token distribution, and latency for each AI model and vendor?
fields.Description: Evaluates model efficiency metrics including total runs, own cost, prompt/completion tokens, median and 95th percentile latency, and cache efficiency percentage.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Aggregates over ModelID and VendorID with optional date range parameters start and end. Computes CacheEfficiencyPct as TokensCacheRead * 100.0 / (TokensPrompt + TokensCacheRead).
